title: Maize good-practice guide
context: Smallholder farmers and extension workers need plain-language, source-cited guidance on maize good-practice.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to maize good-practice summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers maize good-practice as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no farm-specific prescriptions or pesticide dosing
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
